name: leaning-tower
prompt: Make a leaning tower: a square tower 0.4 m wide and 2 m tall whose top is slid 0.5 m sideways (along X) relative to its base, so it leans like a parallelogram, not rotated.

name: rippling-flag
prompt: Make a flag: a cloth panel 1.2 m wide, 0.8 m tall and 0.04 m thick that ripples, with two full waves up its height (a wavelength of 0.4 m) pushing it 0.06 m forwards and backwards (along Z).

name: lumpy-rock
prompt: Make a rock: a sphere of radius 0.5 m made lumpy with smooth random displacement of up to 0.04 m and lumps about 0.3 m across.

name: squashed-pillar
prompt: Make a pillar 0.4 m square and 2 m tall that bulges outward in the middle like a barrel: use a free-form lattice with 3 control points per axis and push the middle ring of control points outward by 0.1 m on X and Z.
